name: Environmental Data Initiative
notes: EML-described data packages, scope.identifier.revision; DOI per revision; PASTA API; DataONE-indexed. `edi` is the open scope any registered user publishes under; `knb-lter-cce` is CCE-LTER's (plan D-6).

name: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
notes: Accessioned archive with a DOI; deposit via Send2NCEI or an NCEI data manager (for NOAA-collected data via SWFSC). Separate from EDI; EDI does not forward.

name: Ocean Biodiversity Information System
notes: Darwin Core Archive (Event core + Occurrence + eMoF) published through an IPT node; CalCOFI uses the OBIS-USA IPT (ipt-obis.gbif.us). One resource per dataset whose taxa resolve to WoRMS (Decision 21).

name: OBIS-USA Integrated Publishing Toolkit
notes: The IPT node that publishes CalCOFI's DwC-A to OBIS and GBIF; upload is manual (Ben's login), gated on a content change.

name: erddap.calcofi.io
notes: CalCOFI's own ERDDAP over the release (EDDTableFromDatabase over DuckDB views); 44 dataset ids (37 current + 7 legacy) at 2026-09-05; ISO 19115-3 and FGDC WAFs at /erddap/metadata/.

name: NOAA CoastWatch / OceanView ERDDAP
notes: NOAA's ERDDAPs serving the SWFSC ichthyoplankton, CUFES, PIC biovolume and SIO hydrographic tables (erdCalCOFI*, siocalcofiHydro*) and the Farallon census (CAC_FI_SBAS_*) — mirrors and sources of the integrated datasets.

name: Zenodo
notes: One DOI per integrated-database release from v2026.09.04 (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22281994) via the GitHub integration on CalCOFI/workflows; archives the pipeline at the tag plus catalog.json/metadata.json.

name: Ocean Data and Information System (ODIS / OIH)
notes: Crawls schema.org JSON-LD from the pages a sitemap lists; ODISCat record 3318 points at calcofi.io's datasets/sitemap.xml (re-pointed at the generated sitemap in Phase 3).

name: Google Dataset Search
notes: Indexes schema.org/Dataset JSON-LD on crawlable pages; the calcofi.io dataset pages carry it from Phase 1.

name: IOOS Catalog (data.ioos.us)
notes: CKAN with pycsw; harvests ISO XML WAFs / CSW registered in the IOOS Harvest Registry (registry.ioos.us). erddap.calcofi.io's ISO 19115-3 WAF is the candidate; 19115-3 acceptance to be confirmed first (plan D-5.4).

name: CalOOS data portal (SCCOOS + CeNCOOS)
notes: The IOOS Regional Association portal; four CalCOFI catalog modules exist from the CoastWatch ERDDAP (2026-09-05); registering erddap.calcofi.io adds a calcofi.io distribution beside each (plan D-5 4b, Decision 17).

name: data.gov (DCAT-US)
notes: Harvests a DCAT-US 1.1 data.json; calcofi.io/data.json is generated from datasets.json in Phase 1.

name: CCE-LTER DataZoo / SIO Ocean Informatics portals
notes: DataZoo catalog pages plus the ZooDB and ZooScan portals (Ohman Lab); downloads behind a data-agreement form or login.

name: UC San Diego Library Digital Collections
notes: Research Data Collections deposits with a DOI (sio_mesopelagic-fish; the Dungeness crab deposit pending).

name: NCBI BioProject / SRA
notes: Sequence data (NCOG 16S/18S metabarcoding, BioProjects 555783 / 665326) — holdings, no ingest.

name: calcofi.org data pages
notes: The program's public narrative and downloads (behind a guest registration form and data-use agreement); the SIO web team is rebuilding it; tiles will link to the calcofi.io dataset pages (Decision 8).
